metadata.purpose: Small internally consistent fixtures for adaptation; not measured soil data or a production save format.
metadata.units: SI; explicit unit suffixes on scalar fields

contract_rules: Commit source debit and destination credit together, or use a durable recoverable pending-transfer record.
A repeated idempotency key returns the recorded result without another transfer.
The source revision is checked before the first application.
Future fill at another density derives a different bulk volume from the same dry mass.
If water is carried or expelled, give it an explicit receiving account.
